sudoers_dir.description: Directory where the sudoers file (or files) are stored.

logfile.description: Full path to the sudo log file. Set to 'syslog' to use system logging.

timestampdir.description: Directory for timestamp files used to track last authentication time.

tmpfile.description: Path to the temporary sudoers file used by visudo.

log_input.description: If true, log user input (stdin) to the sudo log file (requires full logging support).

log_output.description: If true, log user output (stdout/stderr) to the sudo log file (requires full logging support).

requiretty.description: If true, sudo only runs when the user is logged in on a real terminal (tty).

passwd_tries.description: Maximum number of authentication attempts before aborting.

timeout.description: Number of minutes of inactivity after which sudo re-prompts for password.

plugins.description: List of sudo plugins to load, each with a path and optional options.

path.description: Full path to the plugin shared object (e.g., /usr/libexec/sudo/sudoers.so).

env_keep.description: List of environment variables to preserve when running commands via sudo.

items.description: Name of an environment variable to preserve (e.g., 'PATH', 'XAUTHORITY').
